teaching_objective: Compare Fixed Deposits and Mutual Funds visually.

visual_spec.visual_concept: Two contrasting visual worlds side-by-side: a calm, secure bank vault vs a dynamic, growing garden of wealth.
visual_spec.image_generation_prompt: NotebookLM-style educational aesthetic. Rich illustrated storytelling with scenes and visual metaphors. Full-width composition with substantial vertical depth (4:3 ratio). Split screen comparison. Left side: a highly secure, peaceful traditional bank vault with a steady, slow-growing plant. Right side: a dynamic, bright, modern greenhouse with diverse, rapidly growing plants representing diversified portfolios. Light, soft, airy pastel colors.
